race.description: The Reef Hotel Casino Mdn Plate
race.comment: FORMAL AFFAIR (6) has switched yards since finishing fourth two-and-a-half weeks ago over 1200m at Kilcoy. Rates highly and expected to go well. BOOMING BELIEF (4) didn't make an impact at her last run before going for a spell on May 8, finishing fifth and beaten 4 lengths over 1000m at Townsville. Lines up today for the first time for trainer Fred Wieland and shapes as one to consider. NICCO NOTA FIGHTER (1) is back after a break of four months. At the last run before the layoff he finished seventh over 1200m at Townsville. Placed in a recent trial and rates a solid top-three hope. WATEGO'S BAY (9) gave away a big start at the top of the straight last start and finished 8 lengths from the winner in 11th over 1200m at Townsville. Rates highly in this field and can turn things around.
